dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent light-pigmented 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible across the dorsal and lateral surfaces. These structures feature irregular, serrated outer perimeters with high-contrast transitions from dark background pixels to light ring borders, containing lower-intensity internal centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid, non-gradient clusters. Small, localized high-intensity pixel groups are primarily concentrated in the posterior-lateral region adjacent to the tail flipper and sparsely near the neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal surface form an asymmetrical quadrilateral. The spatial relationship between the most anterior dorsal ring and two lower lateral 'C' structures defines a wide-angled triangular cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transverse dermal folds are visible in the cervical region, creating a rhythmic topographical pattern of alternating dark and light shadows.
